svg.title: AI infrastructure data center fabric
svg.desc: An animated dark engineering illustration of GPU pods connected through a full-mesh leaf-spine fabric. Packets travel between GPUs in different pods (GPU to leaf to spine to leaf to GPU) in both ring directions, as in an all-reduce collective.

g.text: GPU racks, leaf-spine switching, EVPN/VXLAN overlay, services, storage, and cloud edge
